partner_result_applied.scope: Every fixed symmetric A with rank at least 3 gives an individually bounded C0 output density under admissible product laws; constant matrix-dependent; independent-review status preserved from source.

mathematical_results: For every nonzero symmetric A, X^TAX is absolutely continuous under every admissible product law.
Rank-one and rank-two examples show AC does not imply Linfinity and Linfinity does not imply existence of a continuous representative.
Combined with the partner theorem, rank three is the sharp universal-for-all-matrices threshold for individually bounded C0 output regularity.
Target family A_T=diag(1,1,1,T^-3), X_4~Unif[T^2,T^2+1] proves there is no uniform tail envelope g(R)->0 for all target C0 densities; p_Q(t_T)>=pi*sqrt(3)/16 while t_T->infinity.
first_unpaid_implication: Prove one dimension- and matrix-independent finite bound on sup_t p_(X^T A X)(t) under the exact three-large-eigenvalue hypotheses.
next_step: Attack height directly via product-coordinate aggregate curvature/grouped-coordinate reductions; do not use qualitative C0 regularity as a uniform-tail or compact-output substitute.
